main: Built Trader Memes as a responsive one-page gallery for 75 curated meme images.
Consolidated the catalog into one typed registry with trader-focused titles, consistent searchable tags, and corrected image metadata.
Added live search, quick tag filters, empty results, accessible announcements, and copy-image behavior with a download fallback.
Streamlined the site around a compact sticky header, always-visible tags, immediate interactions, a minimal footer, and matching browser and home-screen icons.
Established repository validation with full-source test coverage, a required Chromium user journey, project-record checks, and removal of unused code and configuration.
Matched direct unit-test file names to the source files they cover.
